desc: With the rise in popularity of pistol mounted red dots, these Smith & Wesson drop in optic ready slides will turn the widely popular M&P Shield into your new favorite pistol. Featuring and Armornite finish with the classic white 3-dot iron sites, these slides feature a SHIELD SMS and Holosun 507k footprint. This drop in slide is compatible with the M&P 9mm Shield and Shield Plus with 3.1" barrels and utilizes your current barrel.
